headline: A Soles4Souls board member says shoes break the cycle of poverty, and that her happiness comes from giving back.
story: Angela has served on the Soles4Souls board for six years. She says they break the cycle of poverty through things some of us take for granted: shoes and clothing.
Asked if she is happy, she says yes. The source is the ability to give back and serve others.
1.5 million kids in the US face homelessness. New shoes let them hold their head up and blend in. Her message: kindness and care really matter.
